extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia contributors / editors attempting to create or locate an article
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for locating, creating, or troubleshooting a Wikipedia article (here: 'Comedy history book'), including account requirements, searching for existing pages, and handling deleted/recently-created pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmed requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Creators must have a Wikipedia account and meet the autoconfirmed status before creating new articles; this is presented as a prerequisite for creating the requested page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use article wizard or submit a draft / request a new article
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot or should not create a live article directly, use the article wizard to prepare and submit a draft for community review, or file a request for a new article via appropriate channels.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for existing articles / alternative titles or spellings
rubrics_metrics.description: Please search for "Comedy history book" in existing articles to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a page, look for existing coverage under different titles or spellings to avoid duplication; use Wikipedia's search to locate potential matches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check pages that link to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Investigate backlinks to identify mentions, redirects, or related content that may indicate the subject is already covered or linked elsewhere.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recent creation visibility / purge advice
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you expect a newly created page to appear but it does not, allow time for database updates or use the 'purge' function to force-refresh; do not assume absence immediately.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title case sensitivity and redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify capitalization and consider creating redirects from alternate capitalizations or spellings to the canonical title to help users find the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check deletion log if page may have been deleted
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a page is missing, consult the deletion log to determine whether it was removed and review the reasons or guidance on deletion to inform any attempt to recreate or appeal.
